quote.text: An ignorant person is one who is tossed about between elation and despair by external forces and events.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the teaching moment: guide your children to understand that happiness and sorrow arise from within, not solely from external circumstances.
    • Instill resilience and self-awareness early on, so they learn to remain calm and balanced, rather than being swayed by the fleeting dramas of everyday life.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that true leadership lies in controlling one's inner responses—cultivate a mindset anchored in reason and virtue to set a stable example.
    • Encourage your team to focus on what they can control; when storms arise, a leader's calm presence can steer the entire organization toward rational decision-making and steadfast progress.
  • Product Management
    • View external market fluctuations as challenges to be managed with measured strategy, rather than sources of reactive emotional swings.
    • Focus on actionable insights and core values that drive your product's vision; by anchoring your decisions in well-considered principles, you maintain balance amid rapidly shifting landscapes.
